Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that translates our evaluation scope into concrete acceptance tests and owners. High-level summary:

- Timeline: 6-week evaluation window starting Sep 1.
- Success criteria: latency percentiles, cost/unit targets, accuracy / false-positive tolerance on sample prompts.
- Exit gates: go/no-go checkpoints at end of week 2 (integration), week 4 (scale run), and final signoff week 6.

Requested asks from your side:
1) Confirm the two primary personas that will validate outputs (Clinical Ops / Platform).
2) Identify a performance target for 95th percentile latency and a monthly token-cost ceiling.
3) Nominate 3–5 prompt sets for the accuracy acceptance tests.

Attached: clearhealth-map-v1.xlsx (MAP + acceptance checklist) and an initial load-test CSV we ran against a matching model (load-test-results.csv).

I'll loop Marissa and Karthik in for test ownership and integration steps. If this looks right I'll send a version with explicit test scripts and DocuSign-ready terms for the pilot.

Alice — copying a quick clarification and proposed change to the acceptance checklist.

1) False-positive tolerance: define per-test thresholds. Example (suggested):
   - Triage classification: FP rate <= 5% on blind test set (n=500)
   - Billing extraction: acceptable precision >= 92%
   - Summaries: factual-error rate <= 4% measured by spot checks

2) Failure-mode plan (short):
   - Week 4 scale run: if latency or error-rate breaches the threshold for >10% of requests for more than 30 minutes, we trigger rollback to the previous model build and open an incident.
   - We'll provide a lightweight health dashboard (per-route latency & error tags) and an automated fallback policy that routes to a smaller, higher-precision variant.

3) Owners: Karthik will own integration-side validation and the load-run coordination; I'll own acceptance-run orchestration and signoff artifact collection.

Next steps:
- Jonas will deliver the test-script draft by Mon 8/24.
- Alice: please send the 4 prompt sets and contact names.
- Procurement: provide PO checklist items.

Cheers,

Hi all,

I've sketched the integration validation runbook Jonas referenced — short version below, full test scripts attached in the next email. Key points:

- Week 2 (integration): smoke tests (auth, routing, sample prompt responses). Success if >95% of endpoints respond with no schema errors.
- Week 4 (scale): staged ramp to 200 concurrent requests for 45 minutes across representative workloads; capture p50/p95/p99 latency and token-cost.
- Week 6 (final): blind evaluation on the 4 prompt sets + production-like redirects for 72 hours. Acceptance if all per-test thresholds met and no critical security items open.

Decision gates are explicit. If Week 4 fails, we run one remediation cycle (2 business days) and retry the scale run; beyond that we reconvene for go/no-go.

I'll attach the scripts and the exact JMeter/locust commands.

—Karthik
